subject.name: Advanced Machine Learning
subject.course_or_branch: CSE Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

chapters.chapter_name: Introduction to Machine Learning and Data Preparation
content: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Machine
Learning, Types of learning: supervised, unsupervised, semi
supervised and reinforcement learning, Machine learning workflow
Applications of ML in healthcare, finance, manufacturing, retail
cybersecurity and smart systems, Types of datasets
encoding categorical variables, feature scaling, normalization
standardization, feature selection basics, bias-variance tradeoff
Linear regression, multiple linear regression, polynomial regression
Case studies for regression and classification problems

chapters.chapter_name: Advanced Supervised Learning and Model Evaluation
content: Decision tree learning, entropy, information gain, Gini index
Vector Machines, margins, kernels;, Performance evaluation metrics
for classification and regression, Confusion matrix, precision, recall
F1-score, ROC-AUC, MAE, MSE, RMSE, R2
Grid search and random search, Model

chapters.chapter_name: Unsupervised Learning and Dimensionality Reduction Introduction to unsupervised learning; Clustering concepts; k-means
content: Analysis, Feature extraction vs feature selection
high-dimensional data, Applications in recommendation, customer

chapters.chapter_name: Neural Networks and Modern Machine Learning
content: Regularization in neural networks, Introductory concepts of deep
Overview of CNN, RNN and transfer learning, Use cases
of neural networks in image, text and time-series problems

chapters.chapter_name: Real-World Machine Learning Systems, Explainability and Responsible AI
content: ethics, trust, privacy and responsible AI, Model serialization and
retraining, drift awareness and lifecycle management, Mini case
studies based on industry-ready ML solutions
